_howToUpdate: Approved prayer wall requests. Only add a request when the person checked the share box on /prayer AND the pastoral team approved it. First name only, never a last name, address, medical detail, or anything that identifies someone else. Give each a unique id (date plus first name works) and never reuse one. Remove a request when it is answered or after about 30 days; add an "answered" line if the person shares a praise report.
